description: Copilot CLI wiring for the Power BI Desktop TOM/ADOMD hooks. One entry per event runs every check in turn (pbi-hooks.sh pre / post), each gated in-script. Claude Code uses hooks.json instead; see README.md.

PreToolUse.powershell: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; try { & "$env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT\hooks\run-hook.ps1" pbi-hooks.sh pre; exit $LASTEXITCODE } catch { exit 0 }

PostToolUse.powershell: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; try { & "$env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT\hooks\run-hook.ps1" pbi-hooks.sh post; exit $LASTEXITCODE } catch { exit 0 }
